subject: Function-identifier
notes: SR3 (cite.py --check 8.4.3.2.3 'Function-prototype-name-1 shall be the user-function-name of the containing function definition or a function prototype specified in the REPOSITORY paragraph' -> OK §8.4.3.2.3 3)). A name is a user function only if it is in ctx.Data.UserFunctionNames (REPOSITORY) or equals host.UdfSelfName (the containing function). Probe out/probe/function-identifier/p7_sr3.cob: FUNCTION FIP7F with an in-group FUNCTION-ID but no REPOSITORY entry -> COBOL1501 naming the REPOSITORY. The self-name half is covered by conformance:cases/_unassigned/udf_recursion, where UFACT references itself with no REPOSITORY of its own (5! = 120), and by conformance-test UdfInvocationTests.SelfRecursion_WithoutRepositoryEntry_Binds. [code-location note: (UdfSelfName)] || editions as written by the adjudicator: 2002, 2014, 2023 (function-prototype-name form; function-pointer-name form 2014, 2023). Annex E (2014->2023) lists no change to 8.4.3.2
